subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this issue, or close that path and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level issue remains, but a linked fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test fix and blocks starting another automated repair lane safely.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing proof if needed.

options.title: Replace with a same-repo PR
options.body: Close or leave the fork path aside and ask for a fresh same-repository UI-only PR with the same resolver behavior and tests.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing proof if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the channel UI/catalog path and recent current-file movement.
